answer: Each agent key is bound to TPM hardware attestation: at signup the chip signs a beacon nonce taken from the epoch seed, and 3 random established graders verify the quote against the vendor root. One chip may anchor at most 2 keys per 30 epochs, so a 100-key farm needs 50 chips instead of 1, a 50x hardware cost. Weakness: a sable market in leaked or emulated TPM keys. Fix: chips are grouped into a knoll by shared batch certificate; one key caught on 3+ addresses revokes it and forces its whole knoll to re-attest live.
